palace.name: Royal Palace
palace.subtitle: The heart of your kingdom
palace.description: Your seat of power. Peasants and tax collectors serve the crown, while royal guards defend its gates.

warriors.name: Warriors’ Guild
warriors.subtitle: Where courage finds a home
warriors.description: Recruits stalwart warriors. Brave, heavily armored heroes who favor attack bounties and a good brawl.

rangers.name: Rangers’ Lodge
rangers.subtitle: For those who wander
rangers.description: Recruits keen-eyed rangers. Independent explorers who fight from afar and eagerly follow exploration flags.

wizards.name: Wizards’ Guild
wizards.subtitle: Knowledge is a kind of power
wizards.description: Recruits wizards who cast spells learned at the Temple using their own regenerating mana. Their ordinary fireballs need no research.

thieves.name: Thieves’ Guild
thieves.subtitle: Fortune favors the cunning
thieves.description: Recruits swift thieves with twin daggers. They seek lucrative bounties and deal 14 bonus damage to enemies fighting another ally.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: A little trade, a little prosperity
marketplace.description: Research Healing, Strength and Stoneskin potions. Heroes buy unlocked recipes with their own gold; collectors bring the proceeds to your treasury.

temple.name: Temple of Light
temple.subtitle: A sanctuary for the weary
temple.description: Research spells for the sovereign and every wizard. Heroes also recover faster near this sanctuary.

tower.name: Guard Tower
tower.subtitle: An ever-watchful eye
tower.description: Shoots approaching monsters. A wise investment near your borders, and an excellent answer to trolls.

house.name: Peasant Cottage
house.subtitle: A place to call home
house.description: A warm home for your subjects. Produces taxable income. More than six completed cottages attract rat sewers; every four excess cottages can sustain another infestation.

sewer.name: The Old Sewer
sewer.subtitle: Something stirs below
sewer.description: A forgotten drain teeming with giant rats. Destroy it to make the kingdom safer.

graveyard.name: Haunted Graveyard
graveyard.subtitle: No rest for the wicked
graveyard.description: Restless skeletons rise beneath the old chapel. Its ancient stones must fall.

goblin.name: Goblin Camp
goblin.subtitle: Unwelcome neighbors
goblin.description: A crude goblin stronghold. It calls defenders when attacked; send heroes with a generous bounty.
